races.name: Edmundson Electrical CableTec Plymouth Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Having won a couple of points, DEPALMA made a very positive start to life with Dan Skelton at Bangor 2 weeks ago and while this drop back in trip is a slight concern, he can overcome it. Pappano's well-being is something of an unknown but he has the class to be a major factor in this race if running close to his Flat form on return.

  1. DEPALMA (IRE)
  2. PAPPANO
  3. PENZANCE

races.name: Southlands Care Home Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BABS is progressing very well over hurdles and the 5 lb she receives from dual-winner Fine Thing may prove decisive. Kamille Au Kanada is also considered in what looks a competitive race of its type.

  1. BABS
  2. FINE THING
  3. KAMILLE AU KANADA (FR)

races.name: Devondale Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
INTOSOMETHINGGOOD was a much better hurdler than either of his rivals and a chance is taken on him to open his chasing account at the first time of asking. Thickthorn Tom appeals as the best option to chase him home in what could be a tactical race.

  1. INTOSOMETHINGGOOD
  2. THICKTHORN TOM (IRE)
  3. IT'S A BREEZE (IRE)

races.name: Bayside Signs & Display Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
ROYAL TIME is just the type his new yard does well with so gets the vote after an encouraging return in a stronger race at Bangor. Broadway Honey is the obvious threat on the back of her commanding chase debut win, with recent C&D winner Flashy Boy another to consider.

  1. ROYAL TIME (IRE)
  2. BROADWAY HONEY (IRE)
  3. FLASHY BOY (IRE)

races.name: Colin Willcocks Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
REBEL TRIBESMAN is going the right way for the excellent Jamie Snowden team and may well make it 2-2 in handicaps. Service Minimum is feared if back on song following a break.

  1. REBEL TRIBESMAN (IRE)
  2. SERVICE MINIMUM (FR)
  3. KOM TU VOUDRAS (FR)

races.name: Tony McCarthy Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
MR MCWHINNY hasn't looked back since joining this yard, recording a third success from his last 4 starts at Sedgefield on Monday. Remaining well treated under a 7-lb penalty, Tom Ellis' 8-y-o is strongly fancied to continue his winning spree. My Cullen enjoys a 7 lb turnaround with the selection from their recent C&D clash, but he may have to settle for silver again, with the returning Rule Me In best of the rest.

  1. MR MCWHINNY (IRE)
  2. MY CULLEN (IRE)
  3. RULE ME IN (IRE)

races.name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Finale Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A competitive handicap for the grade. FARHH ECHO won readily at Worcester last week and looks capable of defying a penalty. God Of Fire is still attractively handicapped on his Flat form and he heads the dangers, along with dominant last-time-out winner Son Of Hypnos.

  1. FARHH ECHO (IRE)
  2. GOD OF FIRE (IRE)
  3. SON OF HYPNOS (IRE)

races.name: Kennet Valley Syndicates Nick Robinson EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The Roger Teal stable is going better now than when OAKFORD was narrowly denied at Goodwood in June so perhaps this Dark Angel colt can make a successful return from a break. Al Widyan should have more to offer on the back of his Kempton third and is second choice. Hope In Havana and Cornichon are newcomers who could have a say, particularly if the betting speaks in their favour.

  1. OAKFORD (IRE)
  2. AL WIDYAN
  3. HOPE IN HAVANA

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Full Of Surprises British EBF Fillies' Conditions Stakes (GBB Race) (Str)
races.verdict:
Five fillies of potential clash here but SORRENGAIL sets a clear standard on her latest 6f course second and can go one place better now tackling 7f for the first time. Ryan Moore's mount Spirit of Lyra might be the one to follow her home.

  1. SORRENGAIL
  2. SPIRIT OF LYRA (IRE)
  3. SWEETWONDERFULYOU (IRE)

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Nursery (Str)
races.verdict:
Several possibilities in this competitive nursery. Clive Cox has taken this a couple of times in the last 10 years so the suggestion is his Haydock novice winner SILVER SOVEREIGN. The Bookkeeper may have more to offer now returning to 7f and heads the dangers along with Jumeirah Storm, First Mate and Magi Melchior, whose stable has won this 4 times since 2017.

  1. SILVER SOVEREIGN
  2. THE BOOKKEEPER (IRE)
  3. JUMEIRAH STORM (IRE)

races.name: Haynes Hanson & Clark Conditions Stakes (Str)
races.verdict:
BIN JAHWAR only had 2 rivals to beat on his Newmarket debut but couldn't have been much more impressive and is fancied to take the next step up the ladder now. Apulia Bay, another who won easily in a small field last time, is second choice ahead of Impasto and Algaihabane in a race containing several promising sorts.

  1. BIN JAHWAR (IRE)
  2. APULIA BAY (IRE)
  3. IMPASTO

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Cup Stakes (Listed) (Str)
races.verdict:
Marginal preference in this wide-open listed event is for ELARAK who is taken to gain a deserved first success of the season on the back of a good second in listed company at Newmarket. Fondo Blanco also arrives in fine fettle and seems sure to go well but might have to settle for a place again. Spy Chief could bounce back after being poorly drawn in the Wokingham and the upwardly-mobile All Moonshine needs factoring in too.

  1. ELARAK
  2. FONDO BLANCO
  3. SPY CHIEF

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A few of these fillies bring potential but it's hard to side against LADY MAGU who scored in great style on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton and can return from a break to complete her hat-trick. Redbud Sixteen could emerge as the main threat to Roger Varian's filly with this step up in trip a likely plus, although Bintknight and Aphrodite Spirit can also play a prominent role.

  1. LADY MAGU
  2. REDBUD SIXTEEN (IRE)
  3. BINTKNIGHT

races.name: Fitzdares Handicap (GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but it may be worth siding with LOZ VEGAS to capitalise on a handy-looking mark having been dropped 2 lb for his latest effort at Goodwood when twice hampered. Tambora and River Card are another pair who could also have a say.

  1. LOZ VEGAS (IRE)
  2. TAMBORA
  3. RIVER CARD (IRE)

races.name: Fitzdares Handicap (GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
A case can be made for a few of these but EMPIRICAL's form is on an upward curve and he is fancied to resume winning ways after finding only one too good over C&D last time. Interstate remains with few miles on the clock and rates the chief threat on the back of a breakthrough novice success at Newcastle, while Law Court is weighted to go well if shrugging off a lesser effort at Ascot.

  1. EMPIRICAL (IRE)
  2. INTERSTATE
  3. LAW COURT (IRE)

races.name: Weatherbys Stallion Book Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A tricky opener to solve. Preference is for KISS CAM, who didn't get a fair roll of the dice when it mattered in a Lingfield nursery just over 3 weeks ago and Richard Hughes' filly can make amends back in maiden company. The market will no doubt be informative regarding the newcomers, with Zorya, Garden Maze and Queens Bandit making most appeal before the benefit of market clues

  1. KISS CAM (IRE)
  2. ZORYA
  3. GARDEN MAZE

races.name: Guardians Guild & BCMH Collaboration Nursery
races.verdict:
PERFECT HOPE has shown plenty since sent handicapping and can open her account with Loughnane taking over in the saddle. Printing Money should be thereabouts if back on track, with Jazzy Bay another to consider.

  1. PERFECT HOPE
  2. PRINTING MONEY (IRE)
  3. JAZZY BAY (IRE)

races.name: JJX Logistics Going The Distance Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
It's hard to look away from KING SHARJA who is unpenalised for his recent success. Rovinia and Based appeal as the biggest dangers.

  1. KING SHARJA
  2. ROVINIA
  3. BASED (IRE)

races.name: JJX Logistics Going The Distance Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ENJOY THE NIGHT has few miles on the clock and is a big danger if building on his Beverley run at the second attempt. Vitalline can go well again, with Sanditon another to consider with more luck.

  1. ENJOY THE NIGHT (IRE)
  2. VITALLINE
  3. SANDITON (IRE)

races.name: Pertemps Network Handicap
races.verdict:
The lightly-raced POWDER MONKEY gets the vote to follow up from last time. Yaajooz wasn't beaten far on his latest outing and can go well again from the same mark, with Velvet Rhythm also worth a closer look.

  1. POWDER MONKEY (IRE)
  2. YAAJOOZ (IRE)
  3. VELVET RHYTHM

races.name: Dave Hill, Mental Health Ambassador Handicap
races.verdict:
BELLE AMIE recorded her third win of the campaign at Bath on her latest outing, scoring with a bit in hand, and she is taken to add to her tally in her current form. Tenadaay could be the biggest threat with his recent run behind him, while Trojan Truth is also in the mix from what is a handy mark.

  1. BELLE AMIE (SWE)
  2. TENADAAY
  3. TROJAN TRUTH

races.name: Cardway Cartons Box Designer Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
PIPILY wasted no time getting back on track when a close third here at the beginning of the month and she can build on that effort to open her account. Unexposed at around this trip, she is fancied to reverse the form with Melting Snow from last time, while Evening Fades could be thereabouts for her leading yard.

  1. PIPILY
  2. MELTING SNOW (IRE)
  3. EVENING FADES

races.name: Black Country Mental Health 50th Anniversary Handicap
races.verdict:
NIFFLER is unlikely to offer value as a betting proposition, but the percentage call is that he makes it 4-4 in handicaps. Wedonttellthetruth looks the main danger on first start for Fergal O'Brien.

  1. NIFFLER (GER)
  2. WEDONTTELLTHETRUTH (IRE)
  3. SHOPAHOLIC

races.name: GE Starr Engineering...The Brightest Spark Handicap
races.verdict:
COME ON OVER arrives in superb order and there's no reason why he won't give another very bold showing on the back of 2 runner-up efforts since his Redcar win. Horace Wallace is in a better race than at Lingfield but he did that well, while Beauzon is one to keep an eye on in the coming weeks on all-weather.

  1. COME ON OVER (IRE)
  2. HORACE WALLACE
  3. BEAUZON

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Bet 5 Get 30 New Customer Offer' Fillies' Nursery
races.verdict:
DIPLOMATA did very well to catch One Shot Kodi when first and second at Haydock 2 weeks ago so William Haggas's filly can confirm the placings despite a 6 lb swing in the weights. Necromancer is another to consider, especially if conditions become testing.

  1. DIPLOMATA
  2. ONE SHOT KODI (IRE)
  3. NECROMANCER

races.name: Get Home Safe With Thistle Cabs EBF Nursery
races.verdict:
There's depth to this nursery but the eye is drawn to DONTLOOKANYFURTHER who is improving in leaps and bounds ahead of this switch to handicaps from what may well be a good mark. Deputy Vice is a big threat if able to repeat his debut level, while the likes of Crystal Queen and Siouxperb drop down from Group company.

  1. DONTLOOKANYFURTHER (IRE)
  2. DEPUTY VICE (IRE)
  3. CRYSTAL QUEEN (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Stallions Harry Rosebery Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
HICKORY LAD is a likeable and pretty useful juvenile who may well prove too streetwise for his rivals on the back of an excellent third at this level at York 4 weeks ago. Dance A Jig is a big danger if a visor helps his cause, with Nour and Sydney Grace likely improvers.

  1. HICKORY LAD (IRE)
  2. DANCE A JIG
  3. NOUR (IRE)

races.name: Arran Scottish Sprint EBF Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
BEAUTIFUL DIAMOND has an excellent record fresh so she's taken to repeat last year's dominant win following a similar lay-off. Heavenly Heather and Luna A Inbhir Nis are feared most back down in class.

  1. BEAUTIFUL DIAMOND
  2. HEAVENLY HEATHER
  3. LUNA A INBHIR NIS

races.name: Ladbrokes Ayr Bronze Cup Handicap
races.verdict:
It might be worth taking a chance on first-time blinkers sparking a revival from EYE OF DUBAI, who was third in last season's Silver Cup off 5 lb higher before going on to defy the same mark at Ripon a week later. Woven's solid Ayr record (including second in this last year) makes him second choice ahead of Boston Dan, who was back to form with a bang in a tongue tie last time. Wild Clary, French Affair and American Style complete the shortlist.

  1. EYE OF DUBAI
  2. WOVEN
  3. BOSTON DAN (IRE)

races.name: Zenith Ltd Building Partnerships That Last Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
KELPIE GREY looks interesting with a visor added and could be worth a chance if taking up this engagement (entered here on Thursday). Stablemate Motawaared has been knocking on the door and is expected to be thereabouts again, while Eve's Boy is another who could prove well treated if headgear does the trick.

  1. KELPIE GREY
  2. MOTAWAARED
  3. EVE'S BOY

races.name: Zenith Ltd Building Partnerships That Last Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
FILLY EILISH is relatively unexposed for one at a lowly level and could make her first handicap start on turf a winning one. Up The Jazz appeals at the main danger.

  1. FILLY EILISH (IRE)
  2. UP THE JAZZ (IRE)
  3. LITTLE TED

races.name: Slater Menswear Handicap
races.verdict:
A wide-margin winner at Chester last week, CASCADE HALL should be capable of following up from the same mark here. In-form pair Off Spin and Ebony Maw appeal as dangers, along with Irish raider Arch Enemy and last year's winner Just Dottie.

  1. CASCADE HALL (IRE)
  2. ARCH ENEMY (IRE)
  3. OFF SPIN (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Race
races.verdict:
The form of WALK ON HARRY's Cork maiden win is proving solid, so he gets the tentative vote to follow up in what looks a fairly trappy contest. Monologue seems sure to improve on an encouraging opening effort at Down Royal, while it's too soon to be writing off Force Noir given his earlier promise.

  1. WALK ON HARRY (IRE)
  2. MONOLOGUE (IRE)
  3. FORCE NOIR (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
races.verdict:
KINDACAN shaped with considerable promise when third in a big-field Curragh maiden on debut last month and with her stable's 2-y-os usually improving appreciably from starts one to 2, she makes plenty of appeal. Spirit Of The Nite and Tavernise are similarly promising and head up the dangers, along with Always Magic and The Pipeman.

  1. KINDACAN (IRE)
  2. SPIRIT OF THE NITE (IRE)
  3. TAVERNISE (IRE)

races.name: Friday Night Lights Are Back At Dundalk Handicap
races.verdict:
SEND HARRY won this race from a 1 lb higher mark a year ago and has presumably had this race in mind for a while. He could be the answer to what is a competitive affair. Faoladh looks a solid rival, while The Bear Trap demands a market check returning for a new stable.

  1. SEND HARRY (IRE)
  2. FAOLADH (IRE)
  3. THE BEAR TRAP (IRE)

races.name: SIS, Proud Supporters Of Irish Racing Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
Three-time C&D winner PERFECT JUDGEMENT returns to this surface from a career-low mark so he shades the vote over the unexposed Starflow, who responded well to headgear when beating 16 rivals at Cork. Top-weight Usuario Amigo completes the shortlist.

  1. PERFECT JUDGEMENT (IRE)
  2. STARFLOW (IRE)
  3. USUARIO AMIGO

races.name: Start Your Racing TV Free Trial Now Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
PAVILION END hasn't won since scoring on Flat debut over C&D back in January 2025 but Charles O'Brien's 6-y-o has been knocking on the door in recent weeks so gets the nod to double his tally. Nakasero bounced back to his best when finding only Diamond Exchange too strong at Naas last month and that pair can chase home the selection in that order.

  1. PAVILION END
  2. NAKASERO (IRE)
  3. DIAMOND EXCHANGE (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Bet 10 Get 70' Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
The form of ANCHORS AWAY's latest run here is working out well and he could be worth chancing off a 6 lb lower mark. Doctor Grace, Jazz Forever and Without Love all make appeal returning to the all-weather.

  1. ANCHORS AWAY (IRE)
  2. DOCTOR GRACE (IRE)
  3. JAZZ FOREVER (IRE)

races.name: Celebrate Your Special Occasion At Dundalk Stadium Maiden
races.verdict:
NUMANTIA has been shaping up well and can get off the mark following a gelding operation. Trustmore could be the one to follow him home.

  1. NUMANTIA (IRE)
  2. TRUSTMORE (IRE)
  3. SCORCHER'S SON

races.name: T-Met Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Preference is for WORLD AS ONE, who looked more professional than on his first couple of starts over hurdles when going down narrowly at Tramore 5 weeks ago and a repeat should see Willie Mullins' 5-y-o open his account. Lygon Lad got back to something close to his best at Bellewstown recently, so he heads up the dangers, with Nirisque and Blue Trix taken to fight out third.

  1. WORLD AS ONE (GER)
  2. LYGON LAD (IRE)
  3. NIRISQUE (FR)

races.name: Randox Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BEGGARS ROCK arrives chasing a hat-trick after a pair of wins over fences, including at this track, and is taken to exploit his lower hurdles mark. Calm Flight Ahead was much improved when scoring at Sligo last time and rates the chief threat despite a 12 lb rise, while Quint Major has shown signs of a revival and is also respected.

  1. BEGGARS ROCK (IRE)
  2. CALM FLIGHT AHEAD (IRE)
  3. QUINT MAJOR (IRE)

races.name: MB McGrady And Co Chartered Accountants Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
MIGHT BE THE ONE has been knocking on the door of late and is worth chancing in first-time tongue tie. Tropical Twist is best judged on her Wexford win last month and rates the main danger, while John Dixen took a step forward last time and is also respected.

  1. MIGHT BE THE ONE (IRE)
  2. TROPICAL TWIST (IRE)
  3. JOHN DIXEN (IRE)

races.name: MB McGrady And Co Chartered Accountants Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MAD MAXIOS reached a fair level over hurdles for Harry Derham and he is taken to gain a first handicap success as he starts off for his new yard. The main danger could be C&D winner Georginas Jet who hasn't been seen to best effect the last twice, with Jodoro also interesting as he goes handicapping.

  1. MAD MAXIOS (IRE)
  2. GEORGINAS JET (IRE)
  3. JODORO (IRE)

races.name: Kildress Plumbing Suppliers Rated Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
LADY LENA made a winning start over hurdles in a Tramore novice and, with improvement expected, is taken to maintain her unbeaten record in this sphere. Gangster Granny ran poorly on the Flat last time but is a different mare at this track and rates the chief threat, while Brother Walfrid and Mr Master Mac are also respected.

  1. LADY LENA (IRE)
  2. GANGSTER GRANNY (IRE)
  3. BROTHER WALFRID (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
WHISPERING WILLOW shaped with encouragement in a couple of starts over fences earlier in the season and, after taking a notable step back in the right direction over hurdles recently, she looks worth siding with in an ordinary maiden chase. Kalsman rarely runs a bad race at this track and rates the main danger after finishing second over fences last time, while Sea of Doubt is another to consider.

  1. WHISPERING WILLOW (IRE)
  2. KALSMAN (IRE)
  3. SEA OF DOUBT (IRE)

races.name: Vianstown Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
ANODANDAWINK has made a positive start to his chasing career, making it back-to-back wins with something in hand at Kilbeggan last time, and he can land the hat-trick with further progress to come. Next on the list is dual course winner Driveonwill, ahead of Mickey Cohen who won here on his only previous start over fences.

  1. ANODANDAWINK (IRE)
  2. DRIVEONWILL (IRE)
  3. MICKEY COHEN (IRE)

races.name: Dunleath Flat Race
races.verdict:
IFUKNOWUKNOW showed some promise in a pair of bumpers last season, including when behind subsequent Champion Bumper winner The Mourne Rambler in a very warm race at Leopardstown when last seen, and he could well be up to making a winning start for his new yard, especially with this slightly longer trip sure to be in his favour. Myluckymaker sets the standard and should give her running once more, while newcomer Thranduil ticks plenty of boxes on paper.

  1. IFUKNOWUKNOW (IRE)
  2. MYLUCKYMAKER (IRE)
  3. THRANDUIL (IRE)

races.name: Prix Du Bosquet De La Felicite Handicap
Prix Du Jardin Du Piqueur Handicap
Prix Hyacinte Et Mario Bonet - Attele
Prix De La Federation Nationale - Attele
Prix De La Societe Du Trotteur Francais - Attele
Grand Prix De Trot De Cavaillon - Attele
Grand Prix Baron D'ardeuil Aoc Buzet - Attele
